subject: Qualification recap + next steps: buying roles, vendor intake & invoicing
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Qualification recap + next steps: buying roles, vendor intake & invoicing

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery + the asks we discussed so we can keep the procurement loop tight:

Summary:
- Primary use case: embed Redwood Inference into a clinician-facing search workflow (low-latency retrieval + reranking).
- Pilot scope: 3 teams, up to 12 users, 30k monthly tokens during pilot.

Open items / asks from your side:
1) Economic buyer / approval path — who signs the PO? (name + title)
2) Procurement contact & vendor intake requirements (W-9, SOC 2, insurance cert?)
3) Invoice routing and payment terms (net 30/45, remit-to email, AP contact)
4) Security concerns — are there data residency or encryption constraints that would push us to a private deployment?
5) Target timeline for pilot kickoff and PO issuance (ballpark dates)

What I can commit to from Redwood:
- I attached a one-page procurement checklist and our draft SOW (stub) to accelerate intake.
- Marissa will size pilot pricing and provide a canary rollback plan.
- Priyom will coordinate technical onboarding and a short security evidence packet for procurement.

Next steps proposed:
- Can we schedule a 30-minute procurement & finance sync this week with your procurement lead and Daniel (CFO) to confirm PO terms and required documents?
- If you can share the procurement contact and any vendor packet links, we’ll prefill everything before the call.

Attachments: redwood-procurement-checklist.pdf, SOW-draft-v1.pdf (stubs)

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
—
Diego Fernandez
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198
Email: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@orchidhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orchidhealth.com, Daniel Park <daniel.park@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 15:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Qualification recap + next steps: buying roles, vendor intake & invoicing

Thanks Diego — great summary. A few items from our side to clarify: 

1) Economic buyer: Daniel Park, CFO (cc’d). He typically signs PO >$50k.
2) Procurement contact: procurement@orchidhealth.com (cc’d) — they use a standard vendor intake form and require the following: W-9, SOC 2 Type II attestation (or equivalent), certificate of insurance, and a copy of the SLA if there are uptime guarantees.
3) Invoice routing & terms: Orchid runs net 45 standard for new vendors; AP email is ap@orchidhealth.com. Remit-to address is in the vendor portal.
4) Data & security: we run everything in us-west and prefer cloud-only solutions, but we need to understand data retention and whether any PHI touches your system during pilot. If PHI could be in scope, we will need additional controls or an on-prem/private option.
5) Timeline: procurement workflows usually take 30–45 days from vendor packet submission to PO issuance. If the pilot is urgent, we can try to fast-track but will need all docs up front.

I attached the vendor intake form (link below) — please populate and return. We can do a 30-min sync tomorrow afternoon; I’ll defer scheduling to procurement.

Orchid vendor intake form: https://orchidhealth.vendorforms.com/intake/12345 (procurement may also upload directly)

Samira Khan
Director, Product Ops | Orchid Health
samira.k@orchidhealth.com
Office: (206) 555-0112
